pages.text: $(italic)Tank and support: self-sustaining, with group utility. The 'I keep everyone alive' class.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: +10%  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$() none, and no weapon penalties

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Holy Armor$(): +3 armor and +1 toughness. The $(thing)Paladin$() is tanky without giving up as much damage as the $(thing)Vanguard$().$(br2)$(bold)Divine Resilience$(): +10% knockback resistance. Potions, golden apples and healing spells mend you 25% more.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Aura$(): every 5 seconds you heal 1 health while above half health, and other players within 8 blocks heal half a point.

pages.title: Group Play
pages.text: The $(thing)Paladin$() is the only class designed for multiplayer. Healing Aura keeps topping up the players around you, and the tanky stats let the $(thing)Paladin$() hold the front.

pages.title: Group Play, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$(): half damage from fire and +2 armor toughness make a sturdy frontliner.$(br)$(thing)Human$(): +10% XP and no weaknesses, so any group role fits.$(br)$(thing)Orc$(): +20% HP to tank with, and +10% attack speed keeps your damage respectable.$(br2)$(bold)Next: spend points in the Fortitude tree ($(k:puffish_skills.open)).$()
